name: com.nexoider.coreai
description: Portable CoreAI.Core (no UnityEngine): orchestration, Lua sandbox, ILlmClient contracts, AgentBuilder, CoreAISettings. SkillSet — self-service tool groups with on-demand loading via read_skill + call_skill_tool proxy. Only 2 meta-tools visible to the model regardless of total tool count. AgentBuilder.WithSkill/WithSkills fluent API. Unity integration ships in com.nexoider.coreaiunity.
